exact_domain_family: Q(T;V)=P_N\V, where V is the set of visible carrier primes in the fixed carrier assignment
moment_reduction: sum_(q in Q(T;V))(log q)^j/q = S_j(N)-sum_(p in V, p<=N)(log p)^j/p
candidate_73_reduction: 73 pair-slot candidates -> 9 universal scalar prime moments; visible exclusions are explicit finite carrier-prime terms, not new hidden-prime moments
equivalence_rule: Distinct visible sets define distinct assignment-level q-domains unless their intersections with P_N agree; all domains reduce exactly to the same nine master moments plus finite exclusions. No heuristic mask clustering.

layout_masks.identical_iff: visible exclusion sets agree after intersecting [2,N]
layout_masks.conjugate_relation: same q domain and real q moments; conjugation acts on path coefficient only
layout_masks.slot_permutation: same master support P_N; finite exclusions permute with visible carrier assignment
layout_masks.carrier_reversal: same master support; exact domain equal iff visible prime exclusion sets match
layout_masks.asymptotic_relation: for fixed-size visible exclusion sets, moment difference is an explicit finite sum O_j(1), hence relative o(1) versus full M_j main
